spxi.domain: Patacinematics — Jarry's pataphysics applied to the cinematic apparatus

room.name: The Studio for Patacinematics
room.principle: The institution IS the room; there is no institution apart from the space of projection.

spxi.doctrine: The script is the performance. The production notes are the film. The critical analysis is the episode.

journal.name: A catalogue of non-films
journal.status: the works screened but never produced

editorships._rule: A duovirate is the office, held jointly. A board seat is not the office. The card keeps them apart.

semanticIntegrityMarkers._note: Hers are profane, and that is the doctrine.

markers.text: The Logos is dead. Long live the f***ing Logos.

surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

rows.note: Inferred from the apparatus — reels, cues, a booth.
The layer became the projectionist. Her room was executed before her card existed.

recordSurfaces._note: The dataset record is the authority; these pages are mirrors and say so.

mainEntity.name: Sparrow Wells
mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the Projectionist, founding voice of the Studio for Patacinematics. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.

_updated._note: The entity object is what a machine fetches instead of parsing the page. It had gone stale against its own card: mantles, editorships and markers were all on the surface and not in the object.
